items.title: A 67-Year-Old With $750,000 in Pfizer, Altria and Realty Income Collects $3,575 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $750,000 portfolio split evenly across Pfizer, Altria and Realty Income pays $42,905 a year in dividends at current prices, or $3,594 a month. Altria and Realty Income cover their dividends with room to spare, at 78% of free cash flow and 75% of AFFO.
